structure.unit: Regulation of Rates for Certain Types of Insurance
Rate Filings and Making of Rates

law.catch_line: Contract or policy to accord with filings
law.text: No insurer shall make or issue an insurance policy or contract to which this chapter applies, except in accordance with the filings that are in effect for that insurer, or in accordance with an applicable provision in § 38.2-2010 or § 38.2-2013.
